_about: Copy this file to harness.json (which is git-ignored) and list your own projects. root is the project folder (absolute). kit.dir is where the project keeps its copy of the cuppa-ui kit; kit.files picks which kit files it uses. shared (optional) maps a file in this repo's shared/ folder to its place in the project. check is the project's quality-gate script. ui (optional) configures `lint`: sources are the project's own markup, script and stylesheet files (never the vendored kit or generated css), icons is its icons.txt, prefix its storage-key prefix, themeRef the file that must load the kit's theme.js, legacyKeys old storage keys kept only so they can be migrated. regions (optional) maps a shared snippet to a project file that holds it between <!-- cuppa:NAME:start --> and <!-- cuppa:NAME:end --> comments.
